thread:
Aria Summers: quick heads-up 1 running int8/int4 bring-up for q8a with the new pairwise-stitch augment turned on. We see a focused regression on multi-example stitch cases (ordering + bracket drop).

Aria Summers: run snippet: 
```
run_id: q8a-int4-175777
baseline: q8a-fp16-175700
examples: 1184
mismatch_rate: 0.046
cluster: pairwise-stitch (multi-example), signals=[ordering, bracket_loss, early_stop]
notes: failures concentrated where appended examples end with closing bracket / newline trim
```

Ben Torres: which augment variant? pairwise-stitch v0.3 or v0.3-beta with conservative trim? could be tokenizer tail heuristics.

Aria Summers: it's v0.3-beta (adds conservative suffix-trim). Also noticed 3 regen-id collisions with main golden (de-dup flagged).

Clara Mfcller: can you paste 2 sanitized failing samples + fp16 vs int4 outputs? helps decide if it's an overlap vs quant drift.

Aria Summers: sanitized examples below (short):
- "Prompt: Compare [A] vs [B] || appended example: [C]" -> fp16 keeps bracketed bullets, int4 drops closing bracket and moves item order.
- "System: Policy X
User: give steps || appended short QA" -> int4 truncates last bullet and ends early.

Diego Ramos: runtime recently adjusted kernel padding for trimmed prefixes (PR #1012). That changed attention offsets for some batch sizes; suspect KV-index drift for stitched prefixes when int4 kernel selected.

qbench-bot: [qbench] summary: run=q8a-int4-175777 baseline=q8a-fp16-175700 delta_mismatch=+4.6% ci=[+2.9%,+6.4%] top_signals=[ordering,bracket_loss,early_stop] details: https://qbench.local/runs/q8a-int4-175777

Ben Torres: proposed triage: (1) rerun canary excluding `pairwise-stitch` to check augmentation isolation, (2) rerun int4 with `--kernelset=legacy-2026-01` and `--kvcache-trace=on` for 10 failing ids, (3) build micro-golden of 300 stitched-edgecases and run targeted eval.

Clara Mfcller: I'll take (3). I'll generate micro-golden, run a fast fingerprint de-dup against main golden, and include regen-id mapping + sample-stamps. ETA ~6h.

Diego Ramos: I'll do (2). I'll collect KV dumps for 12 failing seeds, include first-512 tokens and sample-stamps, and upload to s3://redwood/qbench/kvdumps/q8a-175777/. If kernel fallback removes delta we should add a runtime guard for trimmed-prefix kernel selection.

Aria Summers: I'll do (1) now and post updated qbench link. Muting pairwise-stitch for baseline and running again.

Ben Torres: also please add `sample-stamp` format "<run>-<seed>-<ts>" to failing ids and put the failing id list in the ticket. Opening INF-1765 to track triage and assign runtime+curation.

qbench-bot: [task] created INF-1765: "q8a-int4: pairwise-stitch trimmed-prefix ordering/bracket regressions" assigned to runtime+curation.

Clara Mfcller: note for curation: when you build the micro-golden, include both stitch+no-stitch variants per seed so we can compare label stability pre/post-augment. Also flag any regen collisions for manual review.

Diego Ramos: quick ask: keep `--kvcache-trace` dumps to first 512 tokens to keep size manageable. attach diffs of KV token indices too.

Aria Summers: thanks team. Will upload run diffs and micro-golden link once Clara finishes. Marking P1 for bring-up until we rule out kernel vs augmentation. :exclamation:
